jobs.description: We are looking for an experienced Project Lead Logistics to lead complex improvement projects within a high-tech logistics and operations environment. In this role, you will combine project management expertise with logistics engineering knowledge to design, implement, and standardize sustainable solutions in a dynamic logistics environment. You will work closely with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to optimize logistics processes, improve operational performance, and support the implementation of innovative warehouse solutions. Wie zoeken we? To be successful in this role, you will have a strong background in logistics project management, logistics engineering, and continuous improvement. Requirements: At least five years of experience as a Project Lead in a logistics or warehouse environment. A proven track record of successfully delivering logistics improvement projects from initiation through implementation and handover. Experience in logistics engineering and the design and implementation of logistics processes and warehouse solutions. A bachelor's or master's degree in Business Engineering, Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, Logistics, or a related field. A recognized project management certification, such as Lean, Six Sigma, PRINCE2, or an equivalent qualification. Experience with Lean methodologies and change management. Strong project leadership, analytical, and decision-making skills. Experience managing project scope, planning, resources, risks, stakeholders, and deliverables. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. A proactive, results-oriented mindset, with the ability to take ownership and work effectively under pressure. Professional proficiency in English. Willingness and ability to meet the required security screening requirements, including obtaining a Certificate of No Objection (VGB). Preferred qualifications: Knowledge of SAP, particularly SAP EWM. Experience with ASRS and warehouautomation solutions. Experience conducting MTM (Methods-Time Measurement) studies. Wat bieden wij je? Salary: Negotiable, depending on experience, qualifications, and expertise. Working hours: 40 hours per week. Working schedule: Day shift. Working location: High-tech logistics environment in the Venlo/Eindhoven region. On-site presence: Primarily on-site, with approximately four days per week in the office and limited opportunities to work from home. Contract duration: Initial assignment of 12 months, with the possibility of an extension up to 24 months, depending on performance and business needs. Additional allowances: Stand-by and overtime allowances apply. Training and development: Access to additional training and professional development opportunities. Work environment: A dynamic, high-tech logistics environment, including occasional work in a cleanroom, where a cleanroom suit must be worn. Pre-employment screening: Enhanced screening is required, including the necessary VGB clearance. Functieomschrijving As a Project Lead Logistics, you will be responsible for managing logistics improvement projects from initiation through implementation and final handover. You will collaborate with stakeholders across Logistics Operations and related departments to deliver measurable and sustainable results. Your responsibilities will include: Lead logistics improvement projects from initiation to implementation and handover. Coordinate cross-functional teams and manage stakeholder relationships. Optimize and standardize logistics processes, systems, and warehouse solutions. Manage project scope, planning, resources, risks, and deliverables. Analyze operations and implement measurable improvements using Lean methodologies. Support SAP EWM and warehouse automation projects, including ASRS. Monitor project progress and ensure alignment with business objectives. You will report to the Group Lead Logistics Projects within Logistics Operations.
